baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence manafi, masharib, and afala yashkurun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Relief or advantage and the intake of liquid form a compact provision inventory; the closing question converts receipt into recognition of the giver.

activation_trace.role: Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the utility side of the inventory.
Taking in liquid supplies the bodily and recurrent use of the provision.
Recognition of a favor and praise of its giver supplies the demanded response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely lists useful things and drinks.
changed_reading.after: The list is an argument: experienced relief and replenishment should disclose a giver and elicit recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural masharib and the beneficiary construction lahum fiha.
baseline_models.mechanism: Masharib can organize water as shares, co-drinkers, and sites or tools of access rather than naming liquid alone. Shukr as a small input with a visible effect then asks whether apportioned access produces a visible human return.

activation_trace.role: An allotted water share turns masharib into distributed access.
A drinking group or shared watering arrangement adds a social relation to access.
A drinking place or implement supplies the infrastructure through which a share becomes usable.
A little provision showing a visible effect makes gratitude a manifested return, not only a feeling.

changed_reading.before: Masharib means an undifferentiated stock of beverages.
changed_reading.after: Masharib can name an apportioned and socially organized water interface whose receipt should become visibly fruitful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of manafi and masharib.
baseline_models.mechanism: Distant but mutually reinforcing branches assemble a material system: leather side pieces, a drinking vessel or place, and conditioning a waterskin so its seams hold. The benefits may include the affordances that make liquid portable and preservable.

activation_trace.role: The leather side pieces of a waterskin give manafi a concrete container component.
A drinking vessel or place turns masharib toward material access.
Water-and-clay conditioning that seals a waterskin supplies the maintenance mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The inventory may also glance at containers, access points, and maintenance that make drinking possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier earth cycle moves from revived ground and flowing springs through fruit and hand-work to the identical gratitude question. The focus becomes the animal counterpart to that plant-water economy: created enabling conditions become food, use, and drink before human response is tested.

activation_trace.role: Benefit anchors the second economy in experienced advantage.
Liquid intake anchors the focus in the same nourishment cycle as the earlier springs.
Recognition of favor closes the focus economy.
Earth revived by rain and growth supplies the earlier economy's enabling transformation.
A flowing water source supplies the hydrological input behind eating and gratitude.
The fruit or outcome of benefit links productive yield directly to manafi.
Intentional work supplies the human contribution without making it the whole causal system.
What hands acquire makes human production visible inside a larger supplied ecology.
The same recognition branch resolves the repeated closing question and binds the two sequences.

structural_cues: 36:33-35 and 36:71-73 both move from a created source through eating or use to the identical afala yashkurun close.
Human hand-work appears in 36:35, while 36:71 places hand-work on the creating side before human ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two production sequences and the same closing question; I supply the arrow that the first interprets the focus as a parallel economy and that supplied conditions qualify human work. They may instead be independent signs sharing a refrain.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated reminder to appreciate animal products.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a paired plant-and-animal account in which gratitude recognizes the created systems underneath eating, labor, ownership, and drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship sequence couples carrying and riding with possible drowning, then names survival as mercy and time-bounded enjoyment. Because riding recurs immediately before the focus, benefits and drinks become contingent access carried across vulnerability rather than permanent holdings.

activation_trace.role: Experienced benefit is the focus-side enjoyment whose permanence is revised.
A water allotment makes drinking access a provision that can be granted or lost.
Recognition answers the contingency of continued access.
Bearing a visible load supplies conveyance as an enabling service.
The vessel moving through water provides the earlier transport analogue.
Riding on a carrier forms the lexical bridge to the ride supplied in 36:72.
Drowning in water exposes the possible withdrawal of safe conveyance.
Mercy supplies the preserving condition between danger and continued use.
Extended preservation for enjoyment makes benefit explicitly provisional.
A bounded time limits the horizon of enjoyment.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 runs from carrying and riding through possible loss to mercy and enjoyment until a time.
36:72 repeats riding immediately before benefits and drinks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the carry-ride-danger-mercy sequence and a later ride-use sequence; I infer a common mechanism of contingent conveyance and extend its time limit to focus benefits. The ship and livestock may instead function as separate signs.

changed_reading.before: Benefits and drinks are stable possessions available to their owners.
changed_reading.after: They are temporarily carried access, preserved across vulnerability, so gratitude answers continued availability rather than mere abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to expend from an apportioned gift and feed another person activates the focus branches of water shares and drinking groups. Lahum marks recipients, but not necessarily the terminal point of provision; gratitude can be enacted by keeping benefit in circulation, while refusal covers the gift.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies what can pass from received advantage to shared relief.
The water share makes allocation internal to masharib.
The drinking group makes access relational rather than exclusively individual.
Recognition of favor anchors circulation as a possible mode of response.
The outgoing movement of wealth supplies the circulation step.
An apportioned gift frames possession as prior receipt.
Covering a blessing supplies the inverse mechanism to grateful disclosure.
Feeding another person supplies the concrete social destination of provision.

structural_cues: 36:47 stages a command to spend from what was provided and a refusal to feed another.
The focus uses the beneficiary plural lahum but does not state that benefit must stop with those recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expenditure, apportioned provision, feeding, and the focus's share-and-group branches; I infer the arrow from grateful receipt to circulation. The live alternative is that 36:47 concerns food or money only and leaves the focus drinks privately held.

changed_reading.before: Lahum presents benefits and drinks as the recipients' endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Receipt creates a circulation test: gratitude may appear as sharing apportioned benefit rather than enclosing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shukr's recognition branch includes response by heart, tongue, and limbs. The surah later makes actions answerable, seals mouths, and lets hands speak and testify about acquisition. The focus question therefore reaches the use made of benefits, not only a spoken formula after consuming them.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies the received capacity whose use becomes accountable.
Recognition through heart, speech, and limbs anchors gratitude as embodied response.
An act met by its return supplies the accountability frame.
Intentional action identifies conduct, rather than possession alone, as what is evaluated.
A secured seal blocks the mouth and removes verbal self-presentation.
Meaningful speech transfers from the sealed mouth to the acting hand.
What hands acquire ties bodily agency to the record of received and used benefit.
Testimony that states known facts makes conduct disclose its own quality.
Acquiring provision or benefit directly links use and gain to the testimony.

structural_cues: 36:54 makes recompense track what people did.
36:65 contrasts a sealed mouth with speaking hands and testifying limbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action-based recompense, limb testimony, and a shukr branch spanning speech and limbs; I infer that use of the focus benefits is itself the grateful or ungrateful answer. The alternative is that the accountability scene is general and the focus asks only for conscious praise.

changed_reading.before: Yashkurun asks for a verbal acknowledgment after enjoyment.
changed_reading.after: Yashkurun asks whether bodies and acquired capacities will use the benefits in a way that can itself testify as gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human ownership in 36:71 depends on prior making and tractability; the focus names what that enabled ownership yields. The next turn seeks help from powerless gods and destabilizes who serves whom, while 36:83 closes with comprehensive dominion. Gratitude keeps usufruct oriented toward its enabling source and marks human ownership as derivative.

activation_trace.role: Benefit is the usable yield that can be mistaken for self-grounded possession.
Recognition of the giver restores the direction from derivative use to enabling source.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the human relation to the livestock.
Making the difficult tractable supplies the condition that makes ownership useful.
Expected aid supplies the misplaced relational return sought from other gods.
Failed aid exposes the incapacity of the chosen source of support.
A mutually supporting host makes the possible reversal of server and served visible.
Comprehensive sovereignty supplies the outer frame within which human disposal is derivative.

structural_cues: 36:71-73 moves from divine making and tractability to human ownership, use, and the gratitude question.
36:74-75 immediately follows with expected but impossible aid and an ambiguously aligned host.
36:83 places the dominion of every thing in one hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabled ownership, failed help, a host relation, and final dominion; I infer that adjacency makes gratitude guard the direction of dependence. In 36:75 the host pronouns can support more than one alignment, so the owner-servant reversal remains suggestive rather than decisive.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is a courtesy owed for property already possessed.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude acknowledges that ownership is enabled usufruct and prevents useful possessions from redirecting dependence toward powerless objects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries shukr's lactation branch into masharib and reads a local drink as a material-conversion sign. It remains anchored in both focus roots and the immediate livestock antecedent, while 36:77-80 supplies a sequence of unlike-from-unlike transformations. Render it only as a possible activation, since masharib can simply mean beverages or watering places and the focus does not name milk.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Masharib beside yashkurun, with the latter's branch of a full udder and abundant milk after pasture.

activation_trace.role: Drinkable liquid anchors milk as one possible concrete member of masharib.
A full udder and abundant milk after pasture supplies the productive-conversion image.
A generative drop supplies the first nearby transformation from slight liquid origin to formed life.
Loss of remembrance makes gratitude's recognition an antidote to forgetting origins.
Origination supplies the general power behind productive material change.
Green luxuriance and good living supply the apparently opposite source material.
Kindled fire supplies the unlike output that makes hidden conversion evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The drinks are passive consumables added to a list of uses.
changed_reading.after: One possible drink is milk, a visible conversion of pasture and water into nourishment and a small-scale analogue of the surah's creation and recreation signs.

strongest_changes: The repeated 36:35 and 36:73 refrain turns the focus into the animal half of a paired plant-and-animal production account.
The ship, feeding, and accountability sequences recast provision as contingent, circulatory, and answerable in use.
The ownership-help sequence and final dominion make gratitude an acknowledgment of derivative rather than self-grounded possession.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned a short inventory into a hinge among ecological production, shared access, bodily accountability, derivative ownership, and material transformation without forcing those readings into one model.
remaining_uncertainties: Masharib may denote beverages, water shares, drinking groups, sites, or implements, and the ayah does not force one scope.
The pronoun alignment in 36:75 limits confidence in the owner-servant reversal.
The milk conversion is branch-backed and contextually live but remains form-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.
